learning_outcomes.text: Ability to define loading types on machine elements.
Determine stresses and deformations under static and cyclic loadings
Understands shafts and axles, designs shafts and axles based on static and fatigue design criteria and performs strength checks.
Defines threaded fasteners (bolts-nuts) and power screws. Designs and performs strength calculations of bolt-nut and riveted joints and power screws.
Defines shaft-hub connections and performs strength calculations. Performs strength calculations of press fits and determines their tolerances.
Defines permanent joints (welded, brazed and bonded). Determines the strength of welded joints and designs weld attributes.

syllabus_topics: Machinery, Machine elements and Engineering Design.
Screws, Threaded Fasteners and Power Screws, Rivets.
Non-Detachable Joints; Welded, Brazed, Bonded Joints.
